Ryan — thanks for a great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the kickoff and success criteria: 

- Scope: baseline search + chat flows for product pages (as discussed) with a single model variant and prefix-kv caching enabled.
- Success criteria (initial):
  - Retrieval+rewrite precision >= 78% on your labeled test set (sample size = 500)
  - Median generation latency <= 220ms for 512-token windows under target traffic (100 rps)
  - No major regression on the top 50 merchant queries
- Timeline: 2-week pilot to validate infra + three-week trial for full evaluation (kickoff Dec 6).
- Ownership: Camila (sales) — commercial/coordination; Ben (SE) — integration/infra; Monica (CS) — instrumentation & eval collection; Lauren (manager) — signoffs & escalation path.

Camila — quick feasibility notes and proposed adjustments: 

- Feasibility: Adding rank + snippet personalization is doable within the pilot with one condition: we run hybrid retrieval (BM25 prefilter + dense re-ranker) and enable per-session KV caching. The extra use case will require a second inference pipeline and additional throughput.
- Resource impact: ~20% more GPU hours during evaluation; expected additional cost = ~120 GPU-hours (p3-equivalent) over the trial.
- Model/config recommendations: keep base model same, enable 8-bit quantization for the re-ranker, use continuous batching up to 64 to hit latency SLOs.
- Updated acceptance thresholds:
  - Macro (top-1) relevance >= 82% (per Ryan)
  - Snippet-quality: BLEU-like score >= 0.62 on the snippet test set (sample size = 300)
  - Latency: 95th <= 450ms for rank+snippet path under 50 rps

Attached: se-config.diff (diff of runtime config changes) and an updated eval matrix (I created quick baseline numbers). If team agrees, I'll produce a short estimate doc for Procurement.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
